title: Concept: Administrative scope granted to a client token
description: A granted scope list that includes an administrative permission in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The scope says the token can change configuration, so any leak of it is an administrative compromise rather than a read-only one.
applicability: Deployments that render a granted scope list that includes an administrative permission into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The scope says the token can change configuration, so any leak of it is an administrative compromise rather than a read-only one.
